source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (model pricing table), read 2026-11-22. USD per million tokens. cache_write is the 5-minute write price (1h writes cost more: fable 16, opus 8, sonnet 4, haiku 0.20); cache_read is 'cache hits and refreshes'. Haiku 5.5 is priced per request by prompt size: 'long' applies when input + cache write + cache read exceeds 100000 tokens. Standard speed, global routing, no batch discount.
